finalCrew.name: Nemi-Vox
finalCrew.quote: I hear the empty places first.
finalCrew.history: Nemi maps by clicking. Pre-collapse ruins answer in a dialect only they still like. Crew wear earplugs. Nemi does not.

finalCrew.name: Rook Halden
finalCrew.quote: Badge is optional. The stare isn’t.
finalCrew.history: Rook marshaled Hope’s Rest until the council asked him to smile more. He took a sabbatical that looks a lot like boarding actions.

finalCrew.name: Jen Park
finalCrew.quote: Aim first. Report never.
finalCrew.history: Jen washed out of Spur security for firing on a “friendly” cutter that turned pirate mid-dock. The station still pretends she quit.

finalCrew.name: Harrow
finalCrew.quote: I already saw the worst angle. This is a better one.
finalCrew.history: Harrow flew the Scar when Eclipse first bit. The eyepatch is a souvenir. The flight logs are a warning. He still takes the stick.
finalCrew.blurb: Scar ace. One eye, no wasted burns.

finalCrew.name: Vex
finalCrew.quote: The note lands. Then the round.
finalCrew.history: Vex learned to shoot by matching crystal harmonics to muzzle rise. Crew find it eerie. Enemies find it brief.
